components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Calculate: the one full-strength action, accent fill with on-accent text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #2fb8a4); color: var(--on-accent, #0f1214); border: none; padding: .85rem 1.2rem; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: .65rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, filter .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(.93); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2fb8a4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { background: var(--panel, #1b2022); color: var(--muted, #a3adb0); filter: none; cursor: progress; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Share: outline button under the result; border turns accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f5f7f8); border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #667377); border-radius: .55rem; padding: .7rem 1.1rem; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2fb8a4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2fb8a4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compact Toggle
components.description: Pause/Play for the journey ticker; same outline treatment, smaller.
components.css: .ds-btn-toggle { background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f5f7f8); border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #667377); border-radius: .55rem; padding: .45rem .85rem; font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2fb8a4); } .ds-btn-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2fb8a4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: Labelled native select or date field on the panel fill.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .25rem; color: var(--text, #f5f7f8); } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { background: var(--panel, #1b2022); border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #667377); border-radius: .55rem; padding: .65rem .8rem; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; accent-color: var(--accent, #2fb8a4); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2fb8a4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: The answer: hero figure, sub-line, reflection question, then hairline-divided sections.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-result { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 1.9rem 1.6rem 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2fb8a4); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--card, #15191b); color: var(--text, #f5f7f8); } .ds-hero { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .25rem .75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-hero-num { font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 15vw, 5.5rem); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--accent, #2fb8a4); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-hero-unit { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-hero-sub { margin: -.5rem 0 0; color: var(--muted, #a3adb0); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-message { margin: .25rem 0 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; max-width: 30ch; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-note { margin: 0; font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--muted, #a3adb0); }

narrative.overview:
Days on Purpose reads like a journal opened at the start of a day: spare, quiet, and pointed at one intention. A single centred column holds three fields, one action, and one answer. The answer is a single large figure, the visitor's purpose days, followed by one question to act on today. Everything else on the result card (the other units, the live journey, sharing, the source note) sits beneath that figure in plain text separated by hairlines.

The page is dark by default (Night Field) and follows the operating system into a light scheme (Dawn Paper). Both schemes share one set of ten role tokens, so every surface, including the result card and the ticker, changes with the scheme. One accent, Purpose Teal, marks what matters: the primary action, the hero figure, the result frame, focus, and selection. The light scheme uses a deeper teal so the accent holds contrast on paper.

Depth is tonal and flat. There are no shadows, gradients, glows, or illustrations. The result card no longer boxes its parts into tiles or insets; its sections are divided by 1px hairlines and carried by type weight and size.
keyCharacteristics: One centred 720px column; three fields, one button, one result card.
One accent per scheme, reserved for action, the hero figure, the result frame, and focus.
A single hero figure leads the result; supporting numbers are plain text in tabular figures.
Sections inside the result card are divided by hairlines, not boxed.
Two complete colour schemes driven by the same role tokens.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each scheme has exactly one chromatic colour, its teal. It marks action, the hero figure, the result frame, and focus, and nothing decorative.

rules.name: The Paired Scheme Rule
rules.body: Every colour is applied through a role token that exists in both schemes. A surface never hard-codes a hex value, so nothing is left behind when the scheme flips.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Secondary text uses the muted token (Mist Grey or Quiet Slate), never opacity on the primary text colour.

rules.name: The One Figure Rule
rules.body: The purpose-days figure is the only text at hero size on the result card. Every other number steps down to unit or ticker size.

rules.name: The Steady Digits Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or lines up with others uses tabular figures, so the live ticker never jitters.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone and 1px lines, never by drop shadow or glow.

dos: Do keep each scheme's teal as its only accent, reserved for action, the hero figure, the result frame, and focus.
Do apply every colour through a role token defined in both the dark and light blocks.
Do use the on-accent token for text on the accent: Night Field on Purpose Teal, Card White on Deep Purpose Teal.
Do use tabular figures for every number that changes or aligns.
Do divide result-card sections with 1px hairlines and keep the values inside them unboxed.
Do keep the source note visible under every result.
Do give fields and outline buttons the field-border token so their edges hold 3:1.
donts: Don't put Purpose Teal (#2fb8a4) on the light scheme's paper or white surfaces; the light scheme uses Deep Purpose Teal.
Don't use a hairline token as the only edge of a control; hairlines are dividers.
Don't add shadows, gradients, or glows.
Don't reintroduce stat tiles or boxed insets on the result card; one hero figure leads and everything else is plain text.
Don't label anything "countdown", "remaining", or "left"; the ticker is a journey, not a clock running out.
Don't add a second accent colour or decorative illustration to the calculator.
